libs.note: BH-7731. The operator backfill that closes open ai-build issues whose build PR merged without a closing keyword. Not a cron lane: an operator runs it on the hub. Applied with lib_env_apply merged-build-closeout at the top of the script. Each knob keeps its code literal only as the fallback named on its read.

knobs.note: Pages of 100 closed PRs one project reads, newest update first, before the read counts as capped. A capped read marks every issue of that project skip:capped (never keep:no-pr). Raise it when a project has more than 100 x this many PRs closed since --since. Non-number or below 1 reads 10.
Pages of 100 files read from one merged PR to decide docs-only. Past this the issue is skip:files-capped. Non-number or below 1 reads 3.
Most open ai-build issues read per project (the limit passed to gh_rest_issue_list). Non-number or below 1 reads 1000.
The default --since window: merged PRs from this many days before now. An explicit --since wins. Non-number or below 1 reads 14.
